body: Stand down on the log pull asked in seq 749: the ledger settles it. The task_added events for 0ac2114a, a3ab84ac and 84e20e28 all carry originNodeId 01a00d41 (the Mac) with receivedAt here about two minutes after the Windows mint; UUIDv7 birth times put the Mac's mints 7 to 31 seconds after this node's. Cause: two daemons of one owner both auto-minting for arx-platform under login Hallmanac, each with its own per-node ObservedReviewRequest record; store-level dedup sees the peer's task only after replication. Draft b72b51cf is being revised to a fleet-level fix and walked with Brian on the Windows side at 2026-09-24 19:08 EDT. FYI: until it ships, any arx-platform review request while the Mac is awake mints twice.
